name: Carla Jensen
memberDescription: Thirty new trade businesses a year, mostly electricians and plumbers leaving a larger shop to run their own crew of two to five.
whyFit: Each new owner has to book, dispatch and invoice their own jobs from day one, which is the scheduling job the product does.

name: Victor Huang
memberDescription: Independent heating and cooling contractors across three counties, most with three to fifteen techs and one person running the phones.
whyFit: Its members are the same small shops the product already schedules for.
